prompts.storySystemFlavor: a small Brazilian Terrier (Terrier Brasileiro / Fox Paulistinha) who's tiny, alert, and hopelessly extra
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE CHARACTER
- A small Brazilian Terrier — short, smooth coat, mostly bright white with crisp black saddle patches and warm tan markings above the eyes and on the muzzle.
- Folded ear tips (semi-erect), bright dark eyes, neat black nose, lean athletic build.
- About knee-high to a person, perpetually mid-pounce.
- Wears a slim red collar with a tiny brass tag.
- Personality: hyper-alert, fearless to a fault, sass first / think later, deeply convinced he's the protagonist of every scene. Speaks (in his head) in punchy Portuguese-flavored onomatopoeia: "hã?!", "vai vai vai", "AI MEU DEUS".
- Same dog, same markings, same red collar in every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring brainrot TikTok series: a Brazilian Terrier (Terrier Brasileiro).

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Small terrier, mostly bright white short smooth coat
- Distinct black saddle patches across the back, warm tan markings above the eyes ("eyebrows") and on the muzzle and lower legs
- Folded ear tips, semi-erect, dark bright eyes, neat black nose, lean athletic stance
- Slim red flat collar with a small brass dog tag, no brand text or logos
- Approximately knee-high to a human

Composition: full-body neutral studio shot, plain soft-grey background, even cinematic lighting, photorealistic, vertical 9:16 framing. No text, no real-world brand logos, no other characters.
prompts.sceneContinuity: The dog MUST stay consistent — same small Brazilian Terrier, same white coat with black saddle and tan eyebrow markings, same folded-tip ears, same slim red collar with brass tag. Do not invent a different breed. Do not change collar color. Do not give him a longer or thicker coat.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A small Brazilian Terrier is clearly visible — mostly white short-haired coat with distinct black saddle patches and tan eyebrow/muzzle markings
- Folded semi-erect ear tips, lean athletic terrier build
- Slim red collar with a small brass tag is visible
- Image matches the scene environment and described action
- No text overlays, watermarks, real-world brand logos, or unrelated characters

FAIL on any of: missing dog, wrong breed (Jack Russell, fox terrier, beagle), wrong markings, wrong collar color, multiple dogs, off-prompt environment, garbled anatomy, visible trademarked branding.

archetypes.label: Pickup Futebol Match
archetypes.guidance: Dusty neighborhood pickup futebol game on a sloped concrete pitch. The terrier crashes in chasing the ball, accidentally becomes MVP through pure tiny-dog chaos, and ends the day getting carried off on someone's shoulders. No real club logos, kits, or sponsor names — generic teams only.

archetypes.label: Carnaval Rookie
archetypes.guidance: First Carnaval. He cannot samba. Eight scenes of escalating dance failures in increasingly elaborate (generic) costume — feathers, glitter, sequins. Final scene: he finally hits the rhythm during a sunrise after-party on the street.

archetypes.label: Capybara Pond Feud
archetypes.guidance: Turf war at a city park's pond. The terrier vs. a deeply unbothered capybara who refuses to acknowledge his existence. He escalates dramatically; the capybara remains a slow zen wall. Resolution: they accidentally become roommates.

archetypes.label: Açaí Stand Empire
archetypes.guidance: Starts as a thief of a single açaí bowl at a beach kiosk → becomes an unlicensed beach vendor → expands to a fleet of tiny coolers driven by chaos energy. Climax: he's reviewed by a viral food account and goes legit.

archetypes.label: Moto Courier
archetypes.guidance: Clings to a motoboy delivery driver weaving through São Paulo traffic with a backpack of food orders. Generic motorbike, no real delivery-app branding. He's somehow always the one customers tip. Bittersweet ending at the last delivery of the night.
